_comment: Generic mid-season player transfer configuration. Each team can list one or more 'changes'. From GW1 up to (effective_gw - 1) the OLD player id is used when fetching/recording FPL data. From effective_gw onward, the id already stored in league.json (== new_player_id) is used as-is. Transfer cost is applied ONCE, only on effective_gw, directly into that GW's team points used for standings.
